decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen is the firm's declared flagship and a seasonal staple tied to its core confectionery competence, so although its web presence fell from its own page to a mention, the result is not far enough below aspiration to trigger dropping a strategic focus product.

The dark barley malt rye bread kept its own page in 2024 while sibling breads A, C and F were pruned, which suggests it met the aspiration level and survived the firm's problemistic search over its bread range.

The marzipan stollen kept its own page in both years, sits close to the established seasonal gift business, and uses existing production capacity at little cost, so there is no performance shortfall calling for its removal.
